description: Topografska osnova 2018. Promet is a dataset listed in DATA - City of Zagreb, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services8.arcgis.com. The GIS database of topographic data of the City of Zagreb contains data on the type of traffic area. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Topographic basis 2018 Transport" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Topografski podaci, Vrsta prometne površine. The listing shows 5 download or service links in CSV, XLSX, GEOJSON, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-grad-zagreb.
